official: 公益的法人等への職員の派遣等に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 提出議案

name: 地方税共同機構を職員の派遣先に追加
summary: 現在、条例で職員を派遣できる団体に地方税共同機構は含まれていません。この議案で派遣先に加え、条例は令和8年4月1日に施行します。
changes: 職員を派遣できる団体に地方税共同機構を加える
派遣に必要な手続を施行日前にも行えるようにする
why: 法律に基づき職員を派遣できる団体に地方税共同機構を追加する必要があるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Adds the Local Tax Joint Organization as a dispatch destination for employees
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on the Dispatch, etc. of Employees to Public-Interest Corporations, etc.
en.summary: The Local Tax Joint Organization is not currently included among the organizations to which employees may be dispatched under the ordinance. This bill adds it as a dispatch destination, and the ordinance will take effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Adds the Local Tax Joint Organization to the organizations to which employees may be dispatched
Allows procedures required for dispatch to be carried out before the effective date
en.why: The ward says this is because the Local Tax Joint Organization needs to be added to the organizations to which employees may be dispatched under the law.
